title: Newsom promises new legal fight after Trump gets Supreme Court victory on mail-in voting
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom says the state will sue again after the Supreme Court's 6-3 ruling allowed Trump's mail-in voting restrictions.

title: Secret Service aware of Iranian video threat targeting Barron Trump, agency says
summary: A video aired on Iranian state media depicts locations tied to Barron Trump and offers a suggested $10 million reward for his exact location.

title: Trump mourns Dolly Parton, orders US flags lowered nationwide after country music icon dies
summary: Trump ordered American flags lowered nationwide for one week in honor of Dolly Parton, calling her death "a true loss for millions of people."

title: Pro-life CEO predicts Trump FDA nominee could bring renewed scrutiny to abortion drug risks
summary: Trump's FDA nominee Heidi Overton could bring renewed scrutiny to mifepristone, says Americans United for Life CEO who calls her a "pro-life" pick.

title: Jeffries brags about Dem obstruction against Trump as he defends Kushner meeting
summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries mentioned his meeting with President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner in a video issued on Monday.

title: Jackson rips into Supreme Court colleagues' 'serious legal error' on Trump mail-in voting order
summary: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson warns of election chaos in a 23-page dissent as the Supreme Court lets Trump's mail-voting executive order proceed.

title: Ohio man charged over graphic threats to kill Trump, behead GOP lawmaker
summary: The FBI arrested an Ohio man who allegedly sent graphic death threats to Jewish Republican Rep. Randy Fine and President Donald Trump via email.

title: Outgoing House Democrat Al Green files another impeachment resolution targeting President Donald Trump
summary: Democratic Rep. Al Green of Texas, who lost a Democratic primary runoff earlier this year, filed a new resolution targeting President Donald Trump for impeachment.

title: Trump taunts Canada on renaming Lake Ontario the 'Lake America' amid rising border trade rift
summary: Trump floats renaming Lake Ontario to "Lake America" and accuses Mark Carney of fabricating claims about French-language demands in trade talks.

title: Former news anchor pleads guilty to stabbing mother to death on Halloween
summary: Angelynn Mock pleaded guilty to first-degree murder after allegedly believing her mother Anita Avers was the devil during the Halloween stabbing.
